messages:
Anna Li: Quick sync request — we need a cross-team agreement on the telemetry contract for per-model/route SLO dashboards. Scope: P50/P95/P99, TTFT (time-to-first-token), tokens/sec, rps. Can we lock metric names/labels + sampling before the next Console sprint?

Devon Park: Agree. Two main questions: 1) where do these metrics get emitted (runtime vs agent vs proxy), 2) allowed label set (cardinality concerns).

Mike R.: From runtime side — we can emit at the point of first token emission and at response end. But batching/continuous-flush complicates TTFT. Proposed per-request fields we can emit: `queue_time_ms`, `start_exec_ms`, `first_token_ms`, `end_exec_ms`, `token_count`. We can compute TTFT = first_token_ms - request_received_ms.

Sara Gomez: Ingestion note: statsd -> vector -> clickhouse (cold) and prometheus-compatible metrics for Grafana (hot). High-cardinality labels will kill the TSDB. We should expose aggregatable histograms and per-request samples only to cold path.

Mike R.: Suggested metric names/shape:
```
# histogram (hot)
inference_request_ttft_ms_bucket{route,model,model_variant,region,customer_tier,le}
# counter (cold)
inference_request_tokens_total{route,model,model_variant,region,customer_tier}
# gauge per-request emitted to cold storage (to compute tokens/sec)
inference_request_tokens_per_sec{route,model,model_variant,region,customer_tier}
```
Compute p95 with PromQL: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_request_ttft_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model))`

Devon Park: Labels we want on dashboards: `route`, `route_id`, `model_id`, `model_variant`, `region`, `customer_tier`, `instance_type`, `batch_size`, `cache_hit` (true/false). Avoid `user_id`, `request_id` as labels. Agreed?

Sara Gomez: +1 but insist we cap model_variant cardinality (map to short ids) and only allow `batch_size` as coarse buckets (e.g., 1, 2-8, 9-32, 33+). Also sample cold-path per-request events for free-tier at 1% to control volume.

Julia N.: Console UX asks: per-route page should show P50/P95/P99 TTFT, tokens/sec median, requests/sec, error_rate, and a small chart overlay for current rollout % (so you can see canary vs baseline). Also need toggles: compare model_version X vs Y, and a time-range selector.

Anna Li: For rollouts — we need a signal from metrics to trigger auto-fallback. Suggest rules: if P95 TTFT increases > 50% and error_rate > 1% for 5m in canary, rollback. How do we wire that?

Mike R.: Runtime can emit `inference_request_fallback_reason{route,model,reason}` as a counter. Routing layer will increment when it falls back to a variant. Alerting can be based on combination: `rate(inference_request_fallback_reason[5m])` and `histogram_quantile(...)` for latency spikes.

Devon Park: Implementation plan: 1) runtime PR to add the five fields + emit histogram buckets to hot metrics; 2) infra to add label mapping & sample rules; 3) platform to create Grafana dashboard templates and promote to Console; 4) QA: synthetic traffic to verify TTFT under batching. Timeline: PRs by EOD Thu, infra config by Mon. OK?

Sara Gomez: Need a clear contract for the telemetry event we send to cold-path. Example event JSON (single-line to cold path):
```
{"ts": 1769971234, "req_id": "req_...", "route": "chat.send", "route_id": "r_42", "model_id": "gpt-red-3b", "model_variant": "q4_8bit_v2", "region": "us-west-2", "customer_tier": "pro", "queue_ms": 12, "first_token_ms": 118, "end_ms": 410, "token_count": 84, "cache_hit": false}
```
This stays in cold storage only; hot metrics are aggregated histograms/counters.

Julia N.: UX question — for the per-route SLO page, can we show aggregated tokens/sec (median) and also a distribution heatmap? That helps spot latency vs throughput tradeoffs.

Mike R.: Yes, tokens/sec is best derived in the dashboard from `sum(rate(inference_request_tokens_total[5m])) by (route,model)` divided by `sum(rate(inference_request_count[5m])) by (route,model)`, or we can emit `inference_request_tokens_per_sec` as a derived gauge per-request to cold path. Hot path computed values are fine for near-real-time.

Anna Li: One last request — include `canary_bucket` label on emitted metrics so we can overlay canary traffic. If that's too high-cardinality, use `is_canary=true/false`.

Sara Gomez: `is_canary` boolean is fine. We'll add sampling rules: no cold per-request for non-pro customers, sample 0.1% for free, 5% for pro, full for enterprise.

Devon Park: I'll draft a telemetry contract PR with metric names, label whitelist, and PromQL examples. Will tag runtime/infra/console folks. Targeting PR by Wed.

Anna Li: Thanks all — please react when you've read and add blockers here. :thumbsup:

metrics-bot: Ingest pipeline change scheduled: vector routing rules updated to drop high-card labels and apply sampling per `customer_tier`. Change in staging @ 1769974500, prod @ 1769978100.

Mike R.: I'll raise the runtime PR this afternoon.

Sara Gomez: I'll post the sampling config + label remap in infra repo after staging test.

Devon Park: Thanks — assigning follow-ups in the ticket.

Anna Li: Closing loop — we will review the draft contract in tomorrow's sync.
